data.revised_prompt: The image is a highly detailed 8K resolution photorealistic industrial design rendering of a foldable quadcopter drone, presented from a strict 90-degree top-down overhead view. The drone is centered in the frame on a dark matte grey studio surface with a clean technical aesthetic. The drone features a streamlined fuselage with a cold grey color scheme and a visible woven carbon fiber frame pattern. Its arms form an X-shaped layout, with the central body featuring a blue LED light band and a discreetly integrated GPS antenna on the top surface. The four arms each hold a reinforced motor cover with an anodized aluminum honeycomb grille underneath. The propellers are made of ABS with a nano-coating, displaying a matte dark grey finish. At the joints where the arms connect to the fuselage, modular quick-release connectors are visible. Around the drone, precise technical annotations and dashed measurement lines connect to specific components. On the left, a dashed line spans between the left propellers with the label '30cm rotor-to-rotor distance' and '1:1 arm span ratio'. An arc diagram near the front-left arm indicates '45° rotor angle'. Near the bottom-right propeller, an arc annotation reads '80cm wing curvature radius'. On the right side, a label points to the central nose with the text '60° fuselage edge angle'. Additional callouts on the upper right identify the 'Reinforced motor covers', 'Modular quick-release connectors', and 'Foldable arms'. At the upper left, a callout labels the 'GPS antenna'. On the lower left, a callout reads 'ABS propellers with nano-coating' and 'Anodized aluminum honeycomb grille'. The lighting is a soft 5500K studio light from above, casting crisp high-contrast shadows below the drone arms and propellers. The typography for all annotations is a clean white sans-serif font with thin white leader lines and arrows, perfectly matching the high-contrast technical illustration style.
